theme: अशुभ संकेत / Adverse omens and the loss of meaning in victory
context: Arjuna has already described the bodily and emotional shock of seeing his relatives on the field. Now the crisis deepens into a moral verdict: the battlefield no longer looks like a heroic opportunity but a scene of spiritual and human collapse.
contextHindi: अर्जुन पहले ही अपने रिश्तेदारों को युद्धभूमि में खड़ा देखकर शरीर और मन की अराजकता अनुभव कर चुके हैं। अब संकट नैतिक निर्णय में बदल जाता है: युद्धभूमि अब वीरता का अवसर नहीं, बल्कि मानवीय और आध्यात्मिक पतन का दृश्य लगने लगता है।
sanskritDevanagari:
निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव |
न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे ||१-३१||
transliteration:
nimittāni ca paśyāmi viparītāni keśava .
na ca śreyo.anupaśyāmi hatvā svajanamāhave ||1-31||

wordByWord.meaning: omens, signs, indicators; not necessarily magic, but the sense that the situation is turning against the intended action.
reversed, contrary, unfavourable; the signs are pointing the opposite of what one hopes for.
Kesava, Krishna; Arjuna addresses Him directly in the moment of crisis.
I do not see what is good, beneficial, or truly profitable; the apparent gain is not morally or spiritually worth the cost.
having killed; Arjuna is imagining the act in full moral weight, not just as a tactical move.
one’s own people, kin; the bond is familial and intimate, not abstract or distant.
in battle; the crisis is concentrated in the battlefield situation itself.

spokenHindi:
अब अर्जुन सिर्फ युद्ध की रणनीति नहीं देख रहे हैं; वे यह समझने लगते हैं कि यह लड़ाई एक ऐसी जटिल नैतिक स्थिति बन गई है जहाँ जीत का अर्थ भी अब स्पष्ट नहीं रहा है। ‘निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि’—उनके लिए सब संकेत उल्टे-से दिखाई दे रहे हैं। ‘न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि’—मैं कोई शुभ, सही, लाभकारी परिणाम नहीं देखता। ‘हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे’—अपने ही लोगों को मारकर लड़ने का विचार मुझे भीतर से धक्का दे रहा है।

यह श्लोक हमें बताता है कि कभी-कभी निर्णय की असली कठिनाई केवल सैद्धांतिक सवालों में नहीं होती; वह उस समय आती है जब आप वास्तविक रिश्ते, पुरानी निष्ठाएँ और भविष्य के परिणाम सब एक साथ सामने देखते हैं। अर्जुन का संकट यह नहीं है कि वे लड़ाई नहीं चाहते; उनका संकट यह है कि लड़ाई के पीछे का ‘शुभ’ अब क्षतिग्रस्त दिखाई दे रहा है।

इसलिए यह श्लोक अंधविश्वास का विषय नहीं है, बल्कि नैतिक जागृति का श्लोक है। जब मन भीतर से कहता है कि ‘यह सही नहीं है’, तो बाहरी संकेत भी उसी दिशा में झुकते हैं। यह मानवीय चेतना का संकेत है, न कि सिर्फ भावुकता का उबाल।
clearEnglish:
This verse is a turning point in Arjuna’s moral self-revelation. He does not say that the battle is impossible in the abstract; he says that in the actual sight of his kin and in the immediate field of action, the signs are adverse and the beneficial outcome is no longer visible. He cannot locate a good that would justify the destruction before him.

The phrase “viparītāni” matters here: the signs are not neutral. The situation is not simply a strategic challenge; it has become ethically charged. Arjuna’s awareness is not a flight from duty but a refusal to treat violence as a detached technical decision. He sees that the cost is not only military; it is relational, emotional, and spiritual.

A meaningful modern application is to pause when the decision before you begins to feel morally inverted: the “gain” seems easy to name but impossible to defend. In such moments, the wise question is not “How do I win?” but “What is the real cost, and is the gain truly good?”

interpretationPerspectives.label: Text
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The verse directly says Arjuna sees adverse omens and cannot perceive any good in killing his own people on the field.

interpretationPerspectives.label: Commentary
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The Divine Life Society reading takes this as a moral and psychological crisis: the battlefield scene itself becomes a sign that the intended action is ethically compromised.

interpretationPerspectives.label: Inference
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: A careful inference is that when a decision involves close relationships and real human loss, the mind often loses clarity about the meaning of success itself.

practicalApplication.label: Notice the moral signal
practicalApplication.text: When a choice begins to feel suddenly wrong even before action, stop and ask: what is being lost that cannot be restored?

practicalApplication.label: Check the real gain
practicalApplication.text: Before pursuing a goal, list the actual benefit and the human cost; if the cost is not worth the gain, the plan needs rethinking.

reflectionQuestion: When a goal begins to feel morally inverted, what is the real cost you are not yet naming clearly?
reflectionQuestionHindi: जब कोई लक्ष्य नैतिक रूप से उल्टा-सा लगने लगे, तो आप वह वास्तविक कीमत क्या हैं जिसे अभी तक साफ़ तौर पर नहीं पहचान रहे हैं?
